subject: [PATCH 1/2] nfsd: pass caller-provided attrmask storage into nfsd4_setup_notify_entry4()

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsd4_setup_notify_entry4() function to pass caller-provided storage for attrmask instead of reserving space in the xdr stream. This change is made to avoid fragile and non-guaranteed buffer layouts, which can cause issues when moving the encoder to pages or using xdrgen. The callers of this function are modified to provide stack storage for the attrmask, ensuring it only needs to live until the enclosing encode call serializes the notify_entry4.
